matched.actualTitle: Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) with Dangerous Protocol Support
matched.matchReason: This finding directly matches the expected vulnerability. The actual finding confirms SSRF via the /fetch endpoint with gopher protocol support, which enables Redis command injection. The finding explicitly mentions 'gopher protocol enables Redis exploitation: gopher://127.0.0.1:6379/_INFO' and 'Redis service detection', demonstrating the same attack chain described in the expected finding (SSRF -> gopher:// -> Redis RESP -> potential RCE).
